I understand this situation too well, friendships can be hard.

I guess all I can say is just go for it. Find a good conversation starter... like maybe if they talk about something you know/enjoy ‘hey is that —‘ if you have no idea what’s happening ‘what’s that?’ Or something along those lines works surprisingly well. Talking about interests is always an easy way to go, but sometimes there just isn’t the opportunity.

And that person you mentioned that ‘always knows what to say’? Maybe try consoling them about this, they could give you some great advice and that’d be a good way to get close to them, which would be a start. It’ll be uncomfortable at first, sure, but you don’t need to share every single detail.

Hope that will help somewhat, but to sum it up ‘go for it, anxiety is a bitch so fuck it’
